Theme block.description: A project's design tokens. The file must be called vixen.ui.vcss and there must be exactly one — two would be two palettes. Declaring --color-brand also declares bg-brand, text-brand and border-brand.

Layer order.description: ⚠ The statement is not optional in a sheet that is concatenated ahead of the generated utilities. Layer order belongs to whoever names a layer first, so without it `components` becomes layer zero and the ladder comes out wrong.

Apply.description: Expands utility class names inside a rule, at build time.

Clear a token namespace.description: How a project says it wants none of a namespace the engine ships. `--color-blue-500: initial` removes exactly one.
